description: Performance baselines for vector search operations

top_20_query_latency_ms.description: Average latency for top-20 vector search queries (TC-P002, TC-S003)

search_scaling_factor.description: Time ratio for 100x limit increase vs 10x limit (should be <10x)

threshold_filtering_overhead_pct.description: Overhead percentage when applying threshold filtering

concurrent_throughput_qps.description: Queries per second with 20 concurrent queries (TC-P003)

notes: Baselines are measured on reference hardware and may vary by system
Tolerance is ±15% to account for hardware variability
Update baselines when making performance improvements
Target values are based on requirements, actual values from recent measurements
